info.title: Hermiq Register
info.description: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud

x-openregister.description: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: A schedule that fires an OpenRegister agent on a cron expression, a fixed interval, or once at a future time.

agentId.description: UUID of the OpenRegister Agent this schedule runs (reference to the Agent entity owned by OpenRegister)

kind.description: Trigger type: run once, on a fixed interval, or on a cron expression

intervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between runs (required when kind=interval)

runAt.description: Timestamp of the single run (required when kind=once)

prompt.description: Optional task text passed to the agent run

deliver.description: Where the run output is delivered

enabled.description: Disabled schedules are skipped by the dispatcher

repeat.description: Optional finite-repeat control; omit or null to run forever

times.description: Total number of runs before the schedule is removed

nextRun.description: Derived: next fire time — written by the dispatcher, not the user

lastStatus.description: Derived: outcome of the last run — written by the dispatcher

lastError.description: Derived: error message from the last run, if any — written by the dispatcher

deliverTarget.description: When deliver=talk, the Nextcloud Talk room token to post to (the owner must be a member). If empty, delivery falls back to the owner's Note-to-self conversation.

lastDeliveryError.description: Derived: the delivery error from the last run, if any — written by the delivery layer; cleared on a successful delivery

requiresApproval.description: When true, a due run does not execute automatically — the dispatcher creates a pending Approval and notifies the reviewer; the run proceeds only after approval (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight).

reviewer.description: Who must approve a gated run — a Nextcloud user id or group id (see reviewerType). If empty, the schedule owner is the reviewer.

reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a Nextcloud user id or a group id.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: A human-oversight approval request for a gated agent run (EU AI Act Art. 14); its status is the audited pending→approved/denied decision.

scheduleId.description: UUID of the Schedule whose run is gated.

agentId.description: UUID of the agent the gated run would invoke.

prompt.description: The prompt the gated run would send to the agent.

requestedAt.description: When the approval was requested (the dispatcher gated the run).

reviewer.description: Resolved reviewer copied from the Schedule — a user id or group id (see reviewerType).

reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a user id or a group id.

decidedAt.description: Derived: when the decision was made — written by the decision endpoint.

decidedBy.description: Derived: the user id who approved or denied — written by the decision endpoint.

reason.description: Optional decision reason (typically supplied on denial).

AiFeature.title: AI feature
AiFeature.description: A design-time inventory entry for a high-risk AI feature this platform provides (EU AI Act registration/oversight). Risk-classified and gated by a declarative lifecycle whose enable transition requires a DPO acknowledgement.

slug.description: The machine identifier of the AI feature (also the IAppConfig dpo_ack key suffix).

name.description: Human-readable name of the AI feature.

description.description: What the AI feature does and why it is risk-relevant.

riskCategory.description: EU AI Act risk classification of the feature.

lifecycle.description: Activation state, managed by the OpenRegister lifecycle engine (never set directly).

tenantId.description: The hermiq multi-tenancy scope used to key the DPO acknowledgement.

dpoAckBy.description: Derived: the user id of the DPO who acknowledged the feature — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

dpoAckAt.description: Derived: when the DPO acknowledgement was recorded — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

TenantControl.title: Tenant control
TenantControl.description: Per-organisation kill-switch. When engaged, the dispatcher halts all agent runs for the organisation (tenant scope comes from ObjectEntity.organisation).

engaged.description: When true, all agent runs for this organisation are halted.

reason.description: Optional reason for engaging the kill-switch.

engagedBy.description: The user id who engaged/disengaged the kill-switch.

Memory.title: Agent memory
Memory.description: An agent's long-term memory (the MEMORY.md port): durable facts stored as JSON entries with a character budget. Exceeding the budget flags needsConsolidation — a nudge to summarise, never a silent truncation.

agentId.description: UUID of the agent this memory belongs to.

entries.description: Memory entries as a JSON array.

charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation (approximate, not a hard cap).

needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget — a nudge to consolidate; older entries are never dropped silently.

UserProfile.title: User profile
UserProfile.description: Facts an agent keeps about a subject user (the USER.md port): durable entries with a character budget and consolidation nudge, scoped to the owning organisation.

agentId.description: UUID of the agent maintaining this profile.

subjectUid.description: The user id the profile describes.

entries.description: Profile entries as a JSON array.

charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation.

needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: A conversation session between a user and an agent (the FTS5 session port). Turns are stored as SessionTurn children so each is individually searchable and org-scoped.

agentId.description: UUID of the agent in this session.

lastActivityAt.description: When the most recent turn was recorded.

SessionTurn.title: Session turn
SessionTurn.description: A single turn within a Session — the searchable unit for cross-session recall via OpenRegister search/vectorization (no bespoke SQLite/FTS5 index).

agentId.description: UUID of the agent (denormalised for recall filtering).

content.description: The turn content — the field searched for recall.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A self-improving agent skill in the agentskills.io format (ported from Hermes). Stores the raw frontmatter block (byte-preserved for lossless round-trip), the body, auxiliary files, a lifecycle state, and which agents it is installed on. Slug namespaced (agentskill) to avoid a cross-app slug collision.

frontmatter.description: The raw agentskills.io YAML frontmatter block, preserved byte-for-byte for lossless serialisation.

state.description: Skill lifecycle state. A skill installed from another org or an external hub starts 'quarantined' and must pass review before 'active' (skills-marketplace).

source.description: Where the skill came from: locally authored, another organisation, or an external hub.

quarantineReason.description: Why the skill is quarantined (set when installed from an external source).

lastActivityAt.description: When the skill was last created/imported/approved — the Curator's staleness clock.

staleSince.description: When the Curator marked the skill stale.

archivedAt.description: When the Curator archived the skill (never hard-deleted).

createdBy.description: The user id who imported/created the skill.

installedOn.description: Agent UUIDs this skill is installed on.

scanReport.description: Heuristic content-scan verdict from OpenRegister ContentScanService, recorded at install and re-checked at approval (skills-marketplace). A 'dangerous' verdict blocks one-click approval.

SkillSource.title: Skill source
SkillSource.description: The origin of a skill (a package, an external agentskills.io hub, or local) — the seam for the V2 skills-marketplace cross-org sharing.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: An autonomous AI agent: its LLM provider/model configuration, RAG and quota settings, visibility, and tool whitelist. Tenant scope (owner/organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what the agent does.

type.title: Type
type.description: Free-form agent type label (e.g. chat, automation, analysis, assistant); no fixed enum observed at HEAD.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider the agent runs on (e.g. openai, ollama, fireworks, azure).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier used by the provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama3).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: System prompt: instructions and context given to the LLM.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may generate per response.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Additional JSON configuration for advanced provider/model settings.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the agent is active and available to run.

enableRag.title: Enable RAG
enableRag.description: Whether Retrieval-Augmented Generation is used to ground responses in context.

ragSearchMode.title: RAG search mode
ragSearchMode.description: Search mode used for RAG context retrieval (e.g. hybrid, semantic, keyword).

ragNumSources.title: RAG number of sources
ragNumSources.description: Number of context sources retrieved for RAG.

ragIncludeFiles.title: RAG include files
ragIncludeFiles.description: Whether Nextcloud files are included as RAG context sources.

ragIncludeObjects.title: RAG include objects
ragIncludeObjects.description: Whether OpenRegister objects are included as RAG context sources.

requestQuota.title: Request quota
requestQuota.description: Maximum number of requests the agent may serve per day (0 = unlimited).

tokenQuota.title: Token quota
tokenQuota.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may consume per day (0 = unlimited).

views.title: Views
views.description: UUIDs of views that filter which data the agent can access.

searchFiles.title: Search files
searchFiles.description: Whether the agent searches Nextcloud files.

searchObjects.title: Search objects
searchObjects.description: Whether the agent searches OpenRegister objects.

isPrivate.title: Private
isPrivate.description: Whether the agent is private (not shared with the whole organisation).

invitedUsers.title: Invited users
invitedUsers.description: User ids invited to access a private agent.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Nextcloud group ids with access to this agent.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool whitelist as {appId}.{toolName} strings; an empty array means every discovered tool is allowed.

user.title: Run-as user
user.description: User id whose permissions and organisation context the agent runs under when there is no active session (e.g. cron/background runs).

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat thread bound to one Agent. Tenant scope and soft-delete/timestamps are inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable conversation title (typically auto-generated by the LLM).

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who owns this conversation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent object this conversation runs against.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata such as a summary, token count, or message count.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: One turn within a Conversation, optionally carrying RAG sources and an AI Chat Companion context snapshot.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation object this message belongs to.

role.title: Role
role.description: Who produced this message: system, user, assistant, or tool.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: RAG sources used to generate the response (assistant messages only).

id.title: Source ID
id.description: UUID of the source file or object.

type.title: Source type
type.description: Whether the source is a file or an object.

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Similarity score of the source to the query.

context.title: Context
context.description: AI Chat Companion context snapshot captured when the message was sent (appId, pageKind, objectUuid, registerSlug, schemaSlug, route, capturedAt), preserved verbatim as free-form JSON.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: A rating on one Message, referencing its Conversation and Agent by uuid. Tenant scope (organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

messageId.title: Message
messageId.description: UUID of the Message this feedback rates.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation the rated message belongs to.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent that produced the rated message.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who submitted this feedback.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the feedback is positive or negative.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Optional free-text comment explaining the feedback.
